description: Deterministically generate a per-section pipeline Work Breakdown Structure from a PipelineSpec. The platform reads the style-family pipeline schema, resolves layer activation and parameter values, and emits the WBS — no thinking model call. Use after the PipelineSpec has been authored to skip thinking-model WBS authoring for per-section pipeline phases.
embedding_description: Deterministically generate work breakdown structure from pipeline specification. Resolve section layers from a pipeline spec and schema. Emit WBS without thinking model. Generate per-section pipeline WBS deterministically. Section stem assembly. Schema-driven WBS generation. Replace thinking-model WBS authoring for pipeline phases.

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The Work Breakdown Structure has been generated deterministically and is now available as working context. Continue executing the current step as shown in the updated ACTIVE_PLAN.
